actions.name: create_event

actions.help: To create a calendar event in Insightly

input.name: TITLE
input.label: Title
input.hint: Maximum length is 255 characters

input.name: LOCATION
input.label: Location
input.hint: Maximum length is 255 characters, Location of the event

input.name: DETAILS
input.label: Details
input.hint: Maximum length is 255 characters, Details of the event

input.name: START_DATE_UTC
input.label: Start date
input.hint: Start date and time of the event, as Coordinated Universal Time

input.name: END_DATE_UTC
input.label: End date
input.hint: End date and time of the event, as Coordinated Universal Time

input.name: ALL_DAY
input.label: All day
input.hint: 'Yes' if it is an all-day event. Default is 'No'

input.name: PUBLICLY_VISIBLE
input.label: Publicly visible
input.hint: 'Yes' if event is visible to others. Default is 'No'

input.name: REMINDER_DATE_UTC
input.label: Reminder date
input.hint: Reminder date and time of the event, as Coordinated Universal Time

input.name: REMINDER_SENT
input.label: Reminder sent
input.hint: True if a reminder was sent
